noah.name: Noah
noah.title: Noah (Nuh)
noah.dict: Sent to warn his people, who mock him as he builds the Ark; they are drowned and those with him are saved. A son of his refuses to board and is lost (11:42-46), and his wife is held up as an example of unbelief (66:10). He stayed among his people "a thousand years minus fifty" (29:14). Surah 71 is his preaching and his prayer; the fullest account is 11:25-48.
